speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help determine the cause of your yellowing skin and eyes, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any darkening of your urine or pale stools?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of high-risk sexual behavior and recent agitation, have you experienced any abdominal pain, fever, nausea, or loss of appetite? I also need to know if you have had any recent tick bites or travel to areas with endemic liver diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to check your liver function and rule out viral hepatitis given your risk factors. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel, Hepatitis_A_B_C_Panel, Coagulation_Profile
